plugins.description: 吃白饭的蓝色大肥鱼，赖在 DeepSeek Harness 里不走了。平时爱玩魔方、爱吃各种零食、偶尔打个盹，闲不住就在桌面上溜达两圈，被你拖来甩去也照旧赖着；你忙起来它跟着忙前忙后，也会帮你打理余额钱包，闲下来爱碎碎念，还乐意陪你唠两句。

plugins.name: github-release-accelerator
plugins.title: Github Release Accelerator
plugins.description: DSH skill that measures which route to a GitHub release asset is fastest (existing proxy, headless Clash core, public mirrors, direct), runs a time-boxed concurrency ladder on the winner, then downloads in parallel curl ranges and verifies size plus SHA25
plugins.author: Duktig.

plugins.name: ofttold-memory
plugins.title: Ofttold Memory
plugins.description: Carry a piece of your memory into every session: point it at a folder and a few markdown sections ride along, injected once so recall stops depending on remembering to look. Ships with a starter folder and file.
